description: A short check for executive assistants and PAs at Merrin & Sallow Architects, a fictional practice, taken before the awareness episodes (pair AB). Ten emails and voicemails from a managing partner's PA inbox. The result is kept so the matching after-check (awareness_post_executive_ab) can show how the two compare. Organiser note: each role's check tests the channel that role meets in its episode, and in a session that runs more than one episode only the learner's primary-role check is recorded.
